question: For a Type C arrow board in Figure 6L-3, state its minimum size, legibility distance, minimum number of elements, and required categories of display modes.
model_answer: Direct Answer: Per Figure 6L-3, a Type C arrow board must be at least 96 x 48 inches in size, be legible from a minimum of 1 mile, and have a minimum of 15 elements. It must also provide three mode selections: (1) a Flashing Arrow, Sequential Arrow, or Sequential Chevron mode; (2) a flashing Double Arrow mode; and (3) a flashing Caution or Alternating Diamond mode. Standards (mandatory): - "Arrow boards shall meet the minimum size, legibility distance, number of elements, and other specifications shown in Figure 6L-3." For Type C, Figure 6L-3 specifies a minimum size of 96 x 48 inches, a minimum legibility distance of 1 mile, and a minimum of 15 elements. - "An arrow board shall have the following three mode selections: A. A Flashing Arrow, Sequential Arrow, or Sequential Chevron mode; B. A flashing Double Arrow mode; and C. A flashing Caution or Alternating Diamond mode." - "Type A, B, and C arrow boards shall have solid rectangular appearances." - "The arrow board shall have suitable elements capable of the various operating modes. The color presented by the elements shall be yellow." Visual evidence: - [Image 1] Figure 6L-3 shows the specification table listing Type C with a minimum size of 96 x 48 inches, minimum legibility distance of 1 mile, and minimum of 15 elements, and illustrates the required display modes (Flashing/Sequential Arrow, Sequential Chevron, Flashing Double Arrow, and Flashing Caution or Alternating Diamond Caution) using a Type C arrow board. - [Image 2] The full page view of Figure 6L-3 confirms the same Type C row (96 x 48 inches, 1 mile, 15 elements) and the three required mode categories, with displays illustrated on a Type C board. - [Image 3] The full page view of Section 6L.06 text confirms the Standard requiring conformance with Figure 6L-3 and the three mandatory mode selections. Citations: - Section 6L.06 Standard §5 (p.833) - Section 6L.06 Standard §7 (p.833) - Section 6L.06 Standard §13 (p.833) - Section 6L.06 Standard §16 (p.833) - Figure 6L-3 (p.834) - Page 875 - Page 874
gold_answer: Minimum size 96 x 48 inches, minimum legibility distance 1 mile, and at least 15 elements. It must provide at least one directional merge mode, the flashing double-arrow mode, and at least one caution mode.
